findings.name: Le Mans 24
findings.evidence_quote: I found Le Mans 24 in Hyper Jumbo, Hyper Maquinas
findings.note: ZIv stub appears to document a Le Mans 24 racing cabinet at Hyper Jumbo / Hyper Maquinas in Maracay, not a distinct named music-game venue. No rhythm-game inventory found. Games table empty. Not enough positive evidence to call confirmed_none.

findings.name: Megajuegos @ Lago Mall
findings.evidence_quote: Pump It Up Infinity Omni Mix; Guitar Hero Arcade
findings.note: ZIv Information lists Pump It Up Infinity Omni Mix (not formalized in Games table which says No games). Insert Coin also lists Pump It Up / Pump It Up Infinity for Megajuegos at C.C. Lago Mall. Guitar Hero Arcade not a catalog slug. Brand active on Instagram @megajuegos.ve / mega_juegos_mcbo with Lago Mall posts. PIU version may have drifted since 2024.

findings.name: Super Video Mania (Mall Paseo San Francisco)
findings.evidence_quote: Stepmania Pump It Up Prime Version; Dance Dance Revolution A20+Om; Guitar Hero PS3 / Guitar Hero Arcade
findings.note: ZIv Information (updated 2026-05-26) claims Stepmania PIU Prime and DDR A20+Om; formal Games table only lists Guitar Hero Arcade (mapped to other), MotoGP Arcade, King of the Hammer. Dance titles not in Games table so treat PIU/DDR as unverified presence. Do not assume same lineup as Sambil La Candelaria branch.

findings.name: Super Video Mania (Sambil La Candelaria)
findings.evidence_quote: ITGmania (North America) ... Cab used to host the DDR A20 plus game, but software was changed to host ITGmania with the Simply-Love theme. ... solía estar ubicado una máquina Pump It Up Phoenix 2023 ... pero esta fue movida a ... El Recreo ... la máquina actual solía tener el juego de Dance Dance Revolution A20 Plus pero fue cambiado al actual ITGMania
findings.note: Current dance cab is ITGmania (SimplyLove) on a former DDR cab: no official slug so mapped to other. Pump It Up Phoenix was present but relocated to Super Video Mania El Recreo (not this sid). Non-rhythm cabs also listed (Daytona, Mario Kart GP DX, King of the Hammer). Half-price Wednesdays noted for dance cab community.

findings.name: Cow Play Cow Moo Crescent Mall
findings.evidence_quote: They don't even have one video game... Okay here's the games. Okay Monster Village, Ice Walker, and Wicked Tuna. That is it. Three video games. There's nothing. They have crane games along there but they belong to Time Zone... You can't even call it an arcade.
findings.note: s34nVideos full-floor walkthrough of CPCM Crescent Mall (L5): redemption/ticket/fishing/casino-style only; three non-rhythm video games; cranes attributed to adjacent Timezone. No maimai/PIU/DDR/etc. ZIv empty games. Contrast: Timezone Crescent Mall is on ALL.Net maimai DX list (separate operator).

findings.name: Cow Play Cow Moo Thiso Mall - Sala
findings.evidence_quote: Games: No games at this location.
findings.note: Same CPCM brand as Crescent (often redemption-heavy) but no independent walkthrough or catalog listing found for Thiso Mall Sala. Do not attach Crescent lineup. Honest unknown.

findings.name: Game World GO! Thái Bình
findings.note: Offline maimai FiNALE (Asia), not DX/ALL.Net. Corroborated by maimai VN Facebook: 'Game World Thái Bình : GO ! Thái Bình ... (1 cab maimai Finale , 2.500VND/xu, 2 xu/credit/4 bài)' and directions 'Trên go thái bình tầng 2 game world'. Slug maimai_dx used for maimai series. FiNALE age/condition: likely still present but not re-verified on-site in 2026.

findings.name: Merpele's kid club
findings.evidence_quote: This luxury hotel in DaLat has Initial D Arcade Stage 8 ∞ / Racing: Initial D Arcade Stage 8 ∞
findings.note: MerPerle Dalat Hotel Kid Club (B1): kids play + paid Game Center + VR per merperledalat.vn/tien-ich/. Only Initial D AS8 documented on ZIv (racing, not a valid rhythm slug). No positive proof that no rhythm cabs exist, so not confirmed_none.

findings.name: Molly Fantasy Sense City Can Tho
findings.evidence_quote: Từ ngày 17/09/2025, Molly Fantasy sẽ chính thức dừng hoạt động tại chi nhánh Sense City Cần Thơ.
findings.note: Official Aeon Fantasy VN closure of Molly Fantasy Sense City Can Tho from 2025-09-17. Prior lineup: ZIv listed maimai DX BUDDiES PLUS (3rd floor); Aeon Fantasy FB listed Sense City Cần Thơ among maimai branches and ran a maimai DX tournament there 2025-03-23. Branch absent from current ALL.Net Vietnam maimai DX locator (35 sites). games field reflects last known rhythm cab before closure.

findings.name: Thế giới vui nhộn (GO! Can Tho)
findings.evidence_quote: maimai FiNALE (Asia) ... Quiet audio but working. Right side has cracked button sometimes doesnt register. Left side screen very dim but working well. Finale 1.99a | đ5000 ($0.20) / 3 songs
findings.note: Offline maimai FiNALE 1.99a at GO! Can Tho 2nd floor (far left / middle). ZIv has score-screen photos. Condition moderate (cracked button, dim screen). Not on ALL.Net DX locator. Re-verify if still powered in 2026.
